player_prompt.intro:
Nyɛ kɛŋa {player_id} le kpɛɛrɛ Indian Poker.
- 52-kɛɛrɛ deck; ɛyɛɛ kɛŋa kɛɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kɛɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ, {max_rounds} kɛɛrɛ kɛɛrɛ.
- Kɛɛrɛ kɛŋa: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X kɛɛrɛ kɛŋa kɛɛrɛ kɛŋa <= ɛyɛɛ chip count.)
- Kɛɛrɛ kɛŋa kɛɛrɛ kɛŋa kɛɛrɛ kɛŋa.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pɛɛ ya kɛ ɖoŋ ŋɖɛ action kɛlɛŋ, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Pɩwɛɛ se liidiye nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa pɛhɛyɩɣ yɔ, ɖɩwɛ 1 yaa pɩkpaɖɩ.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Pɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ kɩ́ pɛ́ɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ɛ́tɛ́; ɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ɛ́ pɩ́ [check] kɩ́ pɛ́ɛ́ɛ́tɛ́ɛ́tɛ́.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Tɩŋnɩ [bet X] yɔɔ nɛ ŋtiyiɣ; nabʋyʋ fɛyɩ se ŋkpaɣ.
invalid_move.insufficient: Pɩtɩkɛ liidiye nɖɩ ɖɩ-yɔɔ papɩzɩɣ nɛ pala mbʋ yɔ.

message.showdown_tie: Kʋñɔŋ tɛma: pa-naalɛ {card}. Pɔɔ taa hɔɔlɩŋ naalɛ, paa weyi lɛ ɛmʋɣ {split}.

outcome.draw: Kpaŋnaŋ tɩŋa taa lɛ, paa weyi ɛ-kɩyakʋ wɛ kʋɖʋmʋʋ.
